title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Senior.Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior.Net Engineer (WFH) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. Power BI Developer – Fabric


About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!

Leads the operation and maintenance of Microsoft Power BI solutions using Azure Cloud data services. This role will support enterprise data reporting and validate data sets for use by the business using a data lake medallion architecture.Supports the daily reporting based on the Power BI environment for the enterprise.

This is a fully remote position.

The role is focused on providing support to the Morrisville, NC (USA) unit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy production ready BI and Analytic solutions
  • Active role in data models, tools, processes, project assessment and development process design for the Power BI Environment.
  • Provide technical overviews and tool demonstrations to BI Power Users, Key Business users and Functional owners, communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Work closely with Key Business users to understand their challenges and translate them into requirements.
  • Organize, create and maintain critical technical and functional documentation for solutions, including best practices, technical specifications, test plans and training materials.
  • Apply Data Level Security for Power BI solutions
  • Ensure Data Governance methods are applied to Power BI solutions.
  • Experience with SQL and relationship databases.
  • Support versioning, archiving, and deployment workflows Dev / Test / Prod environments
  • Lead the Power BI Community of Excellence (global team of citizen developers and analysts to drive innovation, uphold data governance, and deliver strategic insights)


Qualifications

  • Fluent English
  • BA/BS degree and experience in Information Technology
  • Proven success as a Power BI Developer in a multi-national organization using Power BI software and services.
  • Extensive Knowledge of Power BI, Data Analysis & Interpretation, SQL, Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) and communication/collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Hands on ETL/ELT tools, data integration, data pipelines, metadata tools, and database designs
  • Understanding and use of Python and R software (Preferred)

  • Ability to handle long-term goals along with immediate performance concerns.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

We're Hirieng: CRO Specialist


We’re looking for someone who understands user behavior, conversion psychology, and how to turn websites and funnels into measurable business growth.

This is a highly execution-focused role centered around CRO strategy, funnel analysis, UX improvements, experimentation, and performance optimization across both eCommerce and B2B websites.


What you'll do


  • CRO Audits – Conducting conversion rate optimization audits for both DTC and B2B businesses, identifying friction points and opportunities across the funnel;
  • Ecommerce Performance Analysis – Analyzing key metrics, diagnosing underperforming areas, and building structured plans to improve results through A/B testing;
  • Landing Page Strategy & Wireframing – Designing landing page structures with a conversion-first mindset, applying UX and copywriting best practices before any design work begins
  • Loom audits – Recording high-level video audits for potential leads, highlighting quick wins and CRO opportunities tailored to their specific site or funnel;
  • Heatmap & Session Recording Analysis – Using tools like Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and identify drop-off patterns;
  • Funnel Mapping – Identifying where users disengage across the customer journey and prioritizing areas for improvement;
  • Copy Review & Optimization – Evaluating and improving headlines, CTAs, and value propositions to increase relevance and conversions;
  • UX & Friction Analysis – Assessing forms, checkout flows, and navigation to remove barriers to conversion;
  • Competitor Analysis – Benchmarking conversion strategies against competitors to identify gaps and opportunities;
  • Post-Purchase Flow Optimization – Improving upsell, cross-sell, and retention sequences after the initial conversion;
  • Reporting – Tracking KPIs and presenting insights;
  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Working with design and development teams to brief, implement, and QA tests and site changes.


What we're looking for


  • Strong understanding of CRO, UX, and user behavior;
  • Experience working with eCommerce and/or B2B websites;
  • Ability to analyze funnels, session recordings, heatmaps, and conversion data;
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution;
  • Clear communication and presentation skills;
  • Experience creating landing page structures and optimization recommendations;
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong analytical thinking;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.


How we work


  • Remote (EU + Americas);
  • Small team, high ownership;
  • Fast-moving environment focused on quality and measurable impact.


To apply


  • Examples of CRO audits, funnels, or websites you’ve optimized;
  • Landing pages or wireframes you’ve contributed to;
  • Case studies or measurable performance improvements;
  • Short video introduction explaining your experience and approach to CRO.

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.

  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.

  • Advanced English proficiency

  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

QAT Global, a 30+ years IT consulting firm based in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior QA Engineer – AI with strong English communication skills. This position will work directly with US-based teams and collaborate with software developers, QA engineers, and AI-focused stakeholders across our Brazil, Costa Rica, and US operations.


This opportunity is CLT-only in Brazil and can be fully remote.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, integration, and API test strategies
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites for web applications, APIs, and backend services
  • Participate in test planning, test case design, defect tracking, and release validation activities
  • Support CI/CD quality processes and automated test execution within Azure DevOps pipelines
  • Perform API testing using tools such as Postman and validate backend integrations and data flows
  • Execute SQL-based validations and support data integrity testing activities
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to improve software quality and delivery reliability
  • Analyze complex defects, identify root causes, and support resolution efforts across distributed teams
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, automation coverage, and testing standards


AI / LLM Quality Responsibilities

  • Support evaluation and validation activities for AI-generated outputs and LLM-based workflows
  • Participate in prompt regression testing and help identify quality degradation scenarios
  • Assist with evaluation datasets, scoring criteria, and regression validation for AI systems
  • Analyze AI-generated responses, edge cases, hallucinations, and inconsistent outputs
  • Review agent traces, tool-call sequences, and generated outputs to support troubleshooting and quality analysis
  • Collaborate with prompt engineers and developers to improve AI reliability and output consistency
  • Validate AI-generated C# / .NET code and identify logic or architectural inconsistencies


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in Software Quality Assurance and test automation
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar
  • Experience with API testing and REST services validation
  • Experience with SQL and backend data validation
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or similar DevOps platforms
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
  • Ability to work independently in distributed international teams
  • Strong English communication skills


Technical Qualifications

  • Ability to read and validate C# / .NET Core code
  • Familiarity with Entity Framework and backend application validation
  • Understanding of regression testing methodologies and quality assurance best practices
  • Familiarity with non-deterministic system behavior and AI-generated output validation is a plus
  • Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or prompt engineering concepts is a plus


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI/LLM evaluation workflows or AI-assisted software development environments
  • Familiarity with tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Promptfoo, OpenAI Evals, or similar platforms
  • Experience with AI agents, prompt engineering, or generative AI workflows
  • Experience in consulting environments supporting enterprise international clients
  • Experience working directly with US-based stakeholders or distributed global teams


What Makes This Role Different

  • This role combines traditional Senior QA Engineering responsibilities with emerging AI quality and evaluation practices
  • The position includes both structured software testing and AI-generated output validation
  • The engineer will collaborate not only with developers and QA teams, but also with AI-focused engineering and prompt engineering initiatives
  • The environment emphasizes automation, continuous quality validation, and modern software delivery practices


About QAT Global

QAT Global is an international IT consulting firm with more than 30 years of experience delivering technology solutions for enterprise clients. Headquartered in the US, with operations in Brazil and Costa Rica, we specialize in building high-performance distributed teams for global software initiatives.

• Existing relationships with brokers or channel partners

title: Engenheiro de Dados #1004191
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados #1004191 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Precisamos de um(a) Data Engineer para atuar no time de Finance Transformation , apoiando iniciativas de dados relacionadas a processos financeiros, com foco em billing, faturamento, faturas, cobranças, conciliação e indicadores financeiros .

A pessoa deverá atuar na construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados em ambiente Databricks/Lakehouse , garantindo ingestão, transformação, qualidade e disponibilização dos dados para consumo analítico e camada semântica. Também deverá apoiar a preparação de bases e datasets para consumo em Power BI .


Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e hands-on, com boa comunicação para interagir com times de negócio e tecnologia. É importante que tenha visão ponta a ponta dos dados, capacidade de entender regras financeiras e transformá-las em pipelines, modelos e indicadores confiáveis.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

• Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão, tratamento e transformação de dados usando Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Trabalhar com dados de billing, faturas, transações, cobranças, pagamentos, ajustes, estornos e conciliações.

• Garantir consistência dos dados entre camadas de ingestão, preparação, refinamento e consumo.

• Apoiar a criação de datasets, modelos analíticos e indicadores para Power BI.

• Implementar validações de qualidade, reconciliação e rastreabilidade dos dados.

• Documentar fluxos, regras de transformação, dicionário de dados e mapeamentos.

• Interagir com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e finanças.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida como Data Engineer.

• Experiência prática com Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lake/Lakehouse.

• Experiência com Power BI, especialmente preparação de datasets/modelos para consumo analítico.

• Conhecimento de processos financeiros: billing, faturamento, cobrança, contas a receber, conciliação ou pagamentos.

• Experiência com cloud, preferencialmente Azure.

• Conhecimento de governança, qualidade, linhagem e documentação de dados.


Diferenciais

• Experiência em bancos, meios de pagamento, adquirência, fintechs ou ambientes regulados.

• Conhecimento em camada semântica, produtos de dados ou governança corporativa.

• Experiência com Jira, Confluence, Azure Data Factory, Purview ou OpenMetadata.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Consultor(a) SAP VIM (OpenText) | Indirect Tax (Vertex) – EAS-SAP-VIM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) SAP VIM (OpenText) | Indirect Tax (Vertex) – EAS-SAP-VIM em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) SAP VIM (OpenText) | Indirect Tax (Vertex) – EAS-SAP-VIM


  • Data de início: Imediato
  • Tempo de Alocação: 31/12/2026 (Possibilidade de prorrogação)
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa
  • Modalidade: 100% Remoto.
  • Taxa hora: A ser negociado


O que buscamos?


Buscamos profissional com forte experiência em SAP VIM (OpenText) e atuação em iniciativas de Indirect Tax para o Brasil, com participação em implementações SAP S/4HANA e integração com processos fiscais e MM.


A posição exige capacidade de assumir responsabilidade ponta a ponta pela solução, atuar de forma colaborativa com times técnicos e funcionais e apoiar atividades de testes e entrada em produção.


Requisitos (Hard Skills):


  • Experiência em implantação de OpenText VIM para SAP desde o início (from scratch).
  • Participação em implementação SAP S/4HANA.
  • Bom conhecimento de integração com o módulo MM.
  • Experiência sólida em Tax (impostos), com vivência em implementações fiscais no Brasil.
  • Conhecimento de localização LATAM, com foco em Brasil (J1BTAX) e temas de Reforma Tributária.
  • Capacidade de conduzir responsabilidade end-to-end por solução de Indirect Tax em ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento de processos de lançamento de notas fiscais de materiais e serviços, incluindo CT-e.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol intermediário


Qualificação obrigatória:


Especialista/Expert em SAP VIM.


Principais atividades e responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como ponte entre o time de Vertex e as frentes/workstreams cross-funcionais durante as fases de desenho e construção (design & build).
  • Preparar documentos de especificação funcional para evoluções/ajustes relacionados a IDT (Indirect Tax).
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com Basis, desenvolvimento e time funcional para implantação/ativação da aplicação Vertex.
  • Gerenciar os requisitos de impostos indiretos para o Brasil, garantindo entregas no prazo e comunicando riscos potenciais à gestão.
  • Executar e apoiar atividades de testes (Integrated screening, UAT), cutover, Go-live e hypercare (incidentes).


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em Vertex (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em ABAP (desejável).


Maiores detalhes serão compartilhados ao longo do processo seletivo.

title: Cold-Caller (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cold-Caller (Brasil) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're a UK-based marketing agency that works exclusively with aesthetics clinics and training academies. We help them get more clients and course bookings through paid ads and a done-for-you lead generation system.


We're growing and looking for a part-time SDR based in Brazil to join the team remotely.


Let's be honest about what this is: This is a pure sales role at a fast-moving start-up. You'll be cold calling UK businesses, handling objections, getting hung up on, and coming back for more. If that sounds terrifying, this isn't for you. If that sounds like a challenge, keep reading.


What you'll be doing:

  • Cold calling and DM outreach to aesthetics clinic owners and training academies in the UK
  • Booking discovery calls for our director to close
  • Managing prospects in our CRM (GoHighLevel)
  • Following up consistently and professionally


What we're looking for:

  • Based in Brazil: non-negotiable
  • Fluent English: you'll be calling UK businesses daily
  • Thick skin: rejection is part of the job and you know that
  • Hungry: you want commission, you want to grow, you want to win
  • Self-starter: no one will babysit you, you manage your own time and hit your numbers
  • Start-up mentality: things move fast, nothing is perfect, you adapt


What you'll get:

  • Part-time flexible hours
  • Base pay + commission on every deal you help close - paid in Reais

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Precisamos de um(a) Data Engineer para atuar no time de Finance Transformation , apoiando iniciativas de dados relacionadas a processos financeiros, com foco em billing, faturamento, faturas, cobranças, conciliação e indicadores financeiros .

Também deverá apoiar a preparação de bases e datasets para consumo em Power BI .


Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e hands-on, com boa comunicação para interagir com times de negócio e tecnologia. É importante que tenha visão ponta a ponta dos dados, capacidade de entender regras financeiras e transformá-las em pipelines, modelos e indicadores confiáveis.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

• Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão, tratamento e transformação de dados usando Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Trabalhar com dados de billing, faturas, transações, cobranças, pagamentos, ajustes, estornos e conciliações.

• Garantir consistência dos dados entre camadas de ingestão, preparação, refinamento e consumo.

• Apoiar a criação de datasets, modelos analíticos e indicadores para Power BI.

• Implementar validações de qualidade, reconciliação e rastreabilidade dos dados.

• Documentar fluxos, regras de transformação, dicionário de dados e mapeamentos.

• Interagir com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e finanças.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida como Data Engineer.

• Experiência prática com Databricks, Spark/PySpark e SQL.

• Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lake/Lakehouse.

• Experiência com Power BI, especialmente preparação de datasets/modelos para consumo analítico.

• Conhecimento de processos financeiros: billing, faturamento, cobrança, contas a receber, conciliação ou pagamentos.

• Experiência com cloud, preferencialmente Azure.

• Conhecimento de governança, qualidade, linhagem e documentação de dados.


Diferenciais

• Experiência em bancos, meios de pagamento, adquirência, fintechs ou ambientes regulados.

• Conhecimento em camada semântica, produtos de dados ou governança corporativa.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Live Support Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Live Support Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Live Support Representative


Xenia Platform | Remote — Brazil | Full-Time

Department

Customer Success

Location

Remote — Brazil

Employment Type

Full-Time

Language Requirement

English — Fluent (spoken & written)

Working Hours

US business hours overlap required (CST preferred)


About Xenia


Xenia is a frontline operations platform built for multi-unit operators across restaurants, retail, convenience stores, hotels, and hospitality. We help operations teams manage tasks, checklists, inspections, work orders, and team communications — all in one place. Our customers run lean teams across dozens or hundreds of locations, and they rely on Xenia to keep their operations consistent and compliant every day.


We're a Series A-stage company with a growing customer base across the United States. Our team is small, scrappy, and serious about delivering a best-in-class experience to the frontline operators who trust us.


The Role


We are hiring a Live Support Representative to serve as the dedicated live support contact for Xenia customers — handling support over Zoom and Google Meet, not just email or chat queues.


This role exists to own the customer-facing support experience end-to-end: meeting with customers directly over video, troubleshooting issues in real time, answering product questions, and coordinating with our internal QA and engineering teams to ensure bugs get resolved and customers hear back with a clear answer.


Today, this burden falls on our Implementation and Customer Success teams — slowing down onboarding and strategic account work. Your job is to take that entirely off their plate. You will be the first point of escalation for customers who need live support, whether they are three weeks into implementation or two years post-launch.


What You'll Do

  • Own the live support channel — host Zoom and Google Meet sessions with US-based customers to troubleshoot issues, answer product questions, and resolve blockers in real time.
  • Support customers at every stage — whether they are mid-implementation, newly live, or long-tenured accounts, you provide consistent, knowledgeable support.
  • Triage and document issues — clearly document bugs, unexpected behaviors, and feature questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and genuine software bugs.
  • Coordinate with QA and Engineering — file detailed bug reports, track issues through resolution, and proactively circle back with the customer once fixes are deployed.
  • Maintain a customer-facing communication style throughout — you represent Xenia professionally on camera with US customers and set the bar for clarity and calm under pressure.
  • Manage your own queue — track open support items, follow up without being asked, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Collaborate with Implementation and CS teams — hand off relevant context when issues touch onboarding workflows or account health, but take full ownership of the support resolution itself.
  • Contribute to our support knowledge base — document common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps so the team improves over time.


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS customer support experience — you have worked directly with business customers, not just end consumers.
  • Experience conducting live support over video (Zoom, Google Meet, or equivalent) — you are comfortable on camera and can lead a call with a customer you've never met.
  • Fluent English — spoken and written. You will be speaking with US-based operations teams, managers, and occasionally executives on camera. Clear, professional, confident communication is non-negotiable.
  • Ability to work US business hours — specifically Central or Eastern time overlap (9am–6pm CST).
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts — you can systematically work through a problem, isolate the issue, and explain what you found in plain language.
  • Organized and self-directed — you manage your own follow-ups, track open items, and close the loop without needing reminders.
  • Professional on-camera presence — reliable internet, clean background or virtual background, quality audio, and a professional demeanor during customer calls.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with operations, hospitality, restaurant, retail, or convenience store software.
  • Familiarity with feature request/issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear, or similar).
  • Experience working with a QA or engineering team to report and track issues.
  • Prior experience supporting customers in a US SaaS company from a remote/international location.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you have completed onboarding, shadowed existing support calls, and are independently running customer support sessions with light oversight.


By 60 days, you own the live support queue end-to-end — customers are getting timely responses, meetings are being booked and run efficiently, and bugs are being documented and tracked to resolution.


By 90 days, Implementation and CS are no longer fielding reactive support calls. They're focused on implementation and account growth. You are the reason why.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote position — work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct exposure to a US-based growth-stage SaaS company and its customers.
  • A small, high-trust team where your work is visible and your impact is real.
  • Opportunity to grow as Xenia scales — this role is foundational to how we build our support function.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).


The Test:

In order to evaluate candidates, we have developed a test of your After Effects video editing skills, below are instructions and links to all the files you will need to complete it:

If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.

description:

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Overview:

We are a residential cleaning company based in California, USA, with a warm and collaborative team environment. This is a long-term role for someone who would enjoy working closely with a small, hands-on business rather than a large corporate environment.

Internal communication is in Portuguese, while client communication is in English and communication with the cleaning team is in Spanish.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional with a strong sense of responsibility, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work independently after training.

Type of Contract: Independent Contractor, Brazilian MEI. 


Working Hours:  

30 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

There is also an option to work 36 hours per week, which includes 2 Saturdays per month. 


Two schedule options:

  •  7:30am to 1:30pm Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 11:30 to 17:30 Brazil time
  •  12pm to 6pm Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 16:00 to 22:00 Brazil time


Compensation (paid in Brazilian reais):

  • R$ 3.000 per month for 30 hours per week, or R$ 3.600 per month for 36 hours per week
  • Plus a performance-based bonus 


Requirements:
  • Advanced to professional level English required 
  • Basic to intermediate Spanish
  • Strong written and spoken English skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients by phone, text, and email. 
  • Ability to follow procedures and instructions carefully 
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace tools, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive 
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a high-quality headset with voice isolation
  • Quiet, interruption-free workspace during working hours, since you will handle live client calls 



Responsibilities:

  • Answer phone calls in English, handling initial inquiries, asking screening questions, and sharing service information
  • Provide customer support, including email communication with clients 
  • Update and maintain client information in the CRM and other digital records
  • Support administrative tasks, including scheduling and day-to-day follow-through 
  • Use basic to intermediate Spanish for simple text message conversations and occasional basic communication with the cleaning team 
  • Prepare emails and reports


We’re a small, professional, and friendly team, and we’re looking for someone reliable, attentive, organized, and committed to long-term, consistent work. 

To apply:

If this sounds like the right fit for you, please send your resume, along with a 1 to 2 minute video in English sharing a bit about your professional experience, to

Please also include which schedule option you prefer.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Engineering em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Director of Engineering (LATAM Based) - Remote - $175K Base


About the Company:


We are partnering with a fast-growing SaaS platform modernizing complex operational workflows for institutional financial services organizations. Their technology helps enterprise clients streamline onboarding, transaction management, compliance workflows, and stakeholder collaboration through a secure cloud-based platform.


The product is used by sophisticated organizations that require reliability, scalability, and high standards for security and operational excellence. They are focused on reducing operational friction and delivering a seamless digital experience in an industry traditionally dependent on manual processes.


The Opportunity:


We are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead and scale a distributed engineering organization in a high-growth remote environment.


This role will oversee multiple engineering teams and front-line engineering managers across a globally distributed organization. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who excels at building engineering culture, improving operational maturity, and helping teams execute effectively at scale.


You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, and architecture leadership to drive engineering execution, organizational development, and technical excellence.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and mentor engineering managers and technical leaders across multiple teams
  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement
  • Scale engineering operations through effective hiring, onboarding, organizational planning, and career development
  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams
  • Partner with Product and cross-functional leadership to align technical execution with business priorities
  • Establish engineering best practices around architecture, testing, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability
  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment


Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase

Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) SAP VIM (OpenText) | Indirect Tax (Vertex) – EAS-SAP-VIM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) SAP VIM (OpenText) | Indirect Tax (Vertex) – EAS-SAP-VIM


  • Data de início: Imediato
  • Tempo de Alocação: 31/12/2026 (Possibilidade de prorrogação)
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa
  • Modalidade: 100% Remoto.
  • Taxa hora: A ser negociado


O que buscamos?


Buscamos profissional com forte experiência em SAP VIM (OpenText) e atuação em iniciativas de Indirect Tax para o Brasil, com participação em implementações SAP S/4HANA e integração com processos fiscais e MM.


A posição exige capacidade de assumir responsabilidade ponta a ponta pela solução, atuar de forma colaborativa com times técnicos e funcionais e apoiar atividades de testes e entrada em produção.


Requisitos (Hard Skills):


  • Experiência em implantação de OpenText VIM para SAP desde o início (from scratch).
  • Participação em implementação SAP S/4HANA.
  • Bom conhecimento de integração com o módulo MM.
  • Experiência sólida em Tax (impostos), com vivência em implementações fiscais no Brasil.
  • Conhecimento de localização LATAM, com foco em Brasil (J1BTAX) e temas de Reforma Tributária.
  • Capacidade de conduzir responsabilidade end-to-end por solução de Indirect Tax em ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento de processos de lançamento de notas fiscais de materiais e serviços, incluindo CT-e.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol intermediário


Qualificação obrigatória:


Especialista/Expert em SAP VIM.


Principais atividades e responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como ponte entre o time de Vertex e as frentes/workstreams cross-funcionais durante as fases de desenho e construção (design & build).
  • Preparar documentos de especificação funcional para evoluções/ajustes relacionados a IDT (Indirect Tax).
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com Basis, desenvolvimento e time funcional para implantação/ativação da aplicação Vertex.
  • Gerenciar os requisitos de impostos indiretos para o Brasil, garantindo entregas no prazo e comunicando riscos potenciais à gestão.
  • Executar e apoiar atividades de testes (Integrated screening, UAT), cutover, Go-live e hypercare (incidentes).


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em Vertex (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em ABAP (desejável).


Maiores detalhes serão compartilhados ao longo do processo seletivo.
