title: Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.


With a strong international presence, AI/R Company connects talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation for its clients, fostering a collaborative, multicultural environment focused on continuous innovation.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM to lead recruitment strategies for technical positions across different countries in Latin America. This person will be responsible for driving strategic hiring processes, supporting regional leadership in team expansion, and ensuring excellence in both candidate and internal stakeholder experience.


We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

This role will have constant interaction with global stakeholders, technology leaders, and business areas, making strong communication skills, prioritization, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments essential.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the LATAM Talent Acquisition team, fostering development, performance tracking, and best recruiting practices
  • Drive attraction and selection strategies for technical roles across various seniority levels and technologies
  • Actively manage international recruitment processes across Latin America and/or North America
  • Align hiring strategies with technology leaders, operations, and executive leadership
  • Ensure agility, quality, and predictability in recruitment processes
  • Conduct market mapping and develop sourcing strategies for highly specialized profiles
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience
  • Structure and optimize recruitment processes, policies, and tools
  • Participate in global meetings and collaborate with international teams


Required qualifications

  • Strong experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on technical recruiting
  • Previous experience in IT consulting or outsourcing companies
  • Proven experience leading recruitment teams
  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish
  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion
  • Experience in multicultural and high-volume environments
  • Knowledge of ATS systems, recruitment metrics, and TA automation
  • Experience working with global clients in the U.S. or Canada



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and compliance with the most rigorous data protection regulations worldwide, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidates’ data will be kept confidential and used exclusively for recruitment purposes and may be shared with clients and companies within the Compass UOL Group involved in projects.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience of cloud and DevOps experience to join the core team of our U.S. client. In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.g., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Experience with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, compliance)
  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us

CUB specializes in automating receivables and post-sales for Brazilian land developments. Our technology enhances efficiency, reduces delinquency, and offers strategic insights for better decision-making.


About the role

As a Senior Software Developer, you'll join a growing startup with a strong focus on learning and teamwork. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work while you help to improve automation for land developments in Brazil. Your role as a senior member will be crucial in guiding our tech efforts and making a real difference in a supportive environment.


What you'll do

  • Crafting production-ready, shippable code with a strong emphasis on clean code principles.
  • Implement and refine testing strategies for unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality, continuously monitoring system health for reliability and performance.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, and effectively communicating solutions to the team.
  • Work in the DevOps field to provision, configure, and manage infrastructure with Terraform, and automate deployment pipelines for CI/CD workflows.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation and enhance efficiency, while identifying and evaluating open-source and market solutions. This involves discerning when to integrate external services or pursue in-house development, optimizing our development process.


Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum professional experience of 5 years in software development, with a deep focus on Node.js and TypeScript, proficiency in building RESTful APIs, web services and microservices using frameworks like Nest.js or Express.js
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, including deployment, management, and optimization of cloud resources.

title: Engenheiro de Dados/ML Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados/ML Especialista em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados/ML Especialista


Modalidade PJ

Modelo: Remoto Full


Projeto: Sustentação


Descrição Detalhada:

- Um especialista sênior que liderará a criação e gestão dos pipelines de dados que alimentam os modelos analíticos do projeto.

- Será responsável por garantir a qualidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos dados para treinamento e inferência dos modelos de Machine Learning em produção.

- Espera-se que mentore outros membros da equipe e defina as estratégias de engenharia de dados e MLOps.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos Necessários:

- Machine Learning: Profundo conhecimento em algoritmos de Machine Learning e na construção de modelos analíticos de ponta a ponta.

- Engenharia de Dados: Larga experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) com ferramentas como Apache Spark, Airflow ou similares.

- Programação e Bibliotecas: Domínio de Python e suas bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy) e ML (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

- MLOps: Experiência liderando a implementação de práticas de MLOps para versionamento, monitoramento, e retreinamento automatizado de modelos.

- Big Data: Habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em ecossistemas de Big Data (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses).

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para CRO Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Charly Agency is a globally operating boutique digital agency based in Barcelona, Spain. With a highly skilled and agile team, we specialize in crafting high-quality websites with a strong focus on content marketing, UX, and design — helping businesses succeed in the digital space. Our clients range from startups and SMBs to corporate entities, covering industries such as NGOs, B2B, and eCommerce. We primarily work with Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, and Framer.


With a client base predominantly in the USA, Charly Agency is recognized for its expertise in creating high-converting, future-proof websites, apps, and brand assets.


Our core services include:


  • Web design & UX/UI
  • Web and mobile app development
  • Brand strategy
  • eCommerce solutions and CRO
  • Website development and maintenance
  • SEO & Content writing


We're Hirieng: CRO Specialist


We’re looking for someone who understands user behavior, conversion psychology, and how to turn websites and funnels into measurable business growth.

This is a highly execution-focused role centered around CRO strategy, funnel analysis, UX improvements, experimentation, and performance optimization across both eCommerce and B2B websites.


What you'll do


  • CRO Audits – Conducting conversion rate optimization audits for both DTC and B2B businesses, identifying friction points and opportunities across the funnel;
  • Ecommerce Performance Analysis – Analyzing key metrics, diagnosing underperforming areas, and building structured plans to improve results through A/B testing;
  • Landing Page Strategy & Wireframing – Designing landing page structures with a conversion-first mindset, applying UX and copywriting best practices before any design work begins
  • Loom audits – Recording high-level video audits for potential leads, highlighting quick wins and CRO opportunities tailored to their specific site or funnel;
  • Heatmap & Session Recording Analysis – Using tools like Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and identify drop-off patterns;
  • Funnel Mapping – Identifying where users disengage across the customer journey and prioritizing areas for improvement;
  • Copy Review & Optimization – Evaluating and improving headlines, CTAs, and value propositions to increase relevance and conversions;
  • UX & Friction Analysis – Assessing forms, checkout flows, and navigation to remove barriers to conversion;
  • Competitor Analysis – Benchmarking conversion strategies against competitors to identify gaps and opportunities;
  • Post-Purchase Flow Optimization – Improving upsell, cross-sell, and retention sequences after the initial conversion;
  • Reporting – Tracking KPIs and presenting insights;
  • Cross-functional Collaboration – Working with design and development teams to brief, implement, and QA tests and site changes.


What we're looking for


  • Strong understanding of CRO, UX, and user behavior;
  • Experience working with eCommerce and/or B2B websites;
  • Ability to analyze funnels, session recordings, heatmaps, and conversion data;
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution;
  • Clear communication and presentation skills;
  • Experience creating landing page structures and optimization recommendations;
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong analytical thinking;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.


How we work


  • Remote (EU + Americas);
  • Small team, high ownership;
  • Fast-moving environment focused on quality and measurable impact.


To apply


  • Examples of CRO audits, funnels, or websites you’ve optimized;
  • Landing pages or wireframes you’ve contributed to;
  • Case studies or measurable performance improvements;
  • Short video introduction explaining your experience and approach to CRO.

title: Analista de IAM/IGA CyberArk Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de IAM/IGA CyberArk Pleno em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um profissional que poderá atuar na implementação, configuração ou suporte de soluções completas de Identity and Access Management (IAM), abrangendo todo o ecossistema de segurança de identidades:

  • IGA (Identity Governance & Administration), PAM (Privileged Access Management),
  • CIAM (Customer Identity & Access Management),
  • MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication), entre outras.

Importante: Para essa oportunidade, buscamos um profissional que já tenha atuado com projetos de implementação de CyberArk.

Descrição
  • Participar de implantações dos sistemas de IAM, abrangendo todo o ciclo (Requisitos, Desenvolvimento/Configurações, Testes, Homologações e Suporte).
  • Customizar integrações entre os sistemas (APIs, Json, XMLs, SWAGGER, Etc).
  • Desenvolver scripts (Java, Phyton, Etc) para customizações das soluções.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica atualizada (blueprints, procedimentos operacionais)
  • Apoiar em atualizações e upgrades das ferramentas
  • Monitorar status e progresso da resolução de chamados.
  • Garantir atendimento dentro do SLA contratado.
  • Escalar incidentes de alto impacto para os níveis apropriados.
  • Manter clientes informados sobre o status e progresso dos atendimentos.
  • Buscar constantemente novas tecnologias e metodologias de melhoria.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
  • SOs: Conhecimentos básicos em microinformática tais como Linux e Windows Server, redes, segurança;
  • Java: compreender, desenvolver e ajustar códigos na linguagem Java;
  • Linux: compreender e conhecer comandos básicos para servidores Linux;
  • LDAP: conhecimento de protocolos LDAP;
  • JDBC: conhecimentos em banco de dados SQLServer;
  • DevOps: conhecimento em ferramentas de DevOps e Observability (Exs:Terraform, Ansible, DataDog, Grafana).
Diferenciais:
  • Estar cursando ou concluído algum curso de nível superior (bacharel/tecnólogo) na área de Tecnologia;
  • Ter conhecimentos básicos em gestão de identidade;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Ter conhecimento básico em frameworks (Scrum; Kanban; ITIL; Cobit; NIST);
  • Conhecimento e Habilidades com ferramentas e conceitos de IA.
Perfil desejado
  • Tratar as pessoas com ética e sinceridade, buscando uma parceria no longo prazo.
  • Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias, métodos e inovações.
  • Valorizar o aprendizado.
Informações para o candidato
  • Vaga remota.
  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Plano de saúde integral sem coparticipação SulAmérica.
  • Plano odontológico SulAmérica. Bônus anual de até 3 salários, conforme a avaliação de desempenho.
  • Seguro de vida Gympass/WellHub
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação (Valor de R$860,00 para distribuir entre os 2 cartões)
  • Vale Transporte Auxílio Creche.
  • Ajuda de custo de 50% mês para aula de inglês com professor via online.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Operations Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Operations Manager (Liza Edtech)

  • Salary: R$10.000,00 - R$20.000,00
  • Location: 100% remote work. Possibility of in-person work in São Paulo in the future.
  • Type: Full-time


Who We Are & Our Story


Liza is a pioneering EdTech that uses Artificial Intelligence to transform pedagogical management and give time back to educators. Our company combines the operational rigor of the largest educational networks with innovation from Stanford.

  • Lisa Zhang (Founder): Experienced international founder, headquartered in Silicon Valley.
  • Fernando Cofiel (COO): Former COO of Maple Bear for 9 years, with extensive experience in operations scaling and franchising.
  • Rogério Luiz (CTO): PhD in Computer Science with a focus on AI.

We were born to give time back to teachers and deliver data intelligence to public and private administrators.


Who We’re Looking For


We are looking for a high-energy, execution-driven Operations Manager to help us build and scale our company. Someone with a strong startup mindset: fast-moving, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable solving problems in a dynamic environment. This person will work closely with leadership to manage projects, follow up on team execution, improve internal processes, and make sure work is delivered with speed, quality, and accountability.


What You’ll Do


As Senior Operations Manager, you will help keep the company running smoothly and make sure important projects move forward.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing internal projects from planning to execution
  • Following up with team members on task delivery and deadlines
  • Creating clear workflows, processes, and systems
  • Helping leadership track priorities, problems, and next steps
  • Identifying operational bottlenecks and solving them quickly
  • Supporting cross-functional work between sales, product, customer success, and leadership
  • Maintaining a high standard of execution across the team
  • Helping the company operate with more speed, structure, and accountability


The Person We Need


  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Fast-paced, proactive, and execution-focused
  • A quick learner who can adapt quickly
  • Strong at problem-solving and follow-through
  • Comfortable working under pressure
  • Good at project management and team coordination
  • Able to hold themselves and others to high standards
  • Energetic, positive, and easy to work with
  • Comfortable in a startup environment with changing priorities
  • Responsible, reliable, and ownership-driven


Ideal background


  • Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company
  • Experience in operations, project management, business operations, or executive support
  • Experience working with leadership teams or founders
  • Exposure to larger companies or more structured organizations is a plus
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work remotely with discipline and independence
  • Portuguese fluency required
  • English proficiency is a strong plus


Why join HiLiza


HiLiza is building an AI-native education platform designed to support public school systems, teachers, coordinators, and education leaders. This is an opportunity to join an early-stage company with strong growth potential and help build the operational foundation of the business from the ground up.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to be close to leadership, work on important company priorities, and grow with a startup.


How to apply


Please send your resume and a short message explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Include examples of projects, teams, or operations work you have managed before.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software.NET
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta de Software.NET em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

title: Live Support Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Live Support Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Live Support Representative


Xenia Platform | Remote — Brazil | Full-Time

Department

Customer Success

Location

Remote — Brazil

Employment Type

Full-Time

Language Requirement

English — Fluent (spoken & written)

Working Hours

US business hours overlap required (CST preferred)


About Xenia


Xenia is a frontline operations platform built for multi-unit operators across restaurants, retail, convenience stores, hotels, and hospitality. We help operations teams manage tasks, checklists, inspections, work orders, and team communications — all in one place. Our customers run lean teams across dozens or hundreds of locations, and they rely on Xenia to keep their operations consistent and compliant every day.


We're a Series A-stage company with a growing customer base across the United States. Our team is small, scrappy, and serious about delivering a best-in-class experience to the frontline operators who trust us.


The Role


We are hiring a Live Support Representative to serve as the dedicated live support contact for Xenia customers — handling support over Zoom and Google Meet, not just email or chat queues.


This role exists to own the customer-facing support experience end-to-end: meeting with customers directly over video, troubleshooting issues in real time, answering product questions, and coordinating with our internal QA and engineering teams to ensure bugs get resolved and customers hear back with a clear answer.


Today, this burden falls on our Implementation and Customer Success teams — slowing down onboarding and strategic account work. Your job is to take that entirely off their plate. You will be the first point of escalation for customers who need live support, whether they are three weeks into implementation or two years post-launch.


What You'll Do

  • Own the live support channel — host Zoom and Google Meet sessions with US-based customers to troubleshoot issues, answer product questions, and resolve blockers in real time.
  • Support customers at every stage — whether they are mid-implementation, newly live, or long-tenured accounts, you provide consistent, knowledgeable support.
  • Triage and document issues — clearly document bugs, unexpected behaviors, and feature questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and genuine software bugs.
  • Coordinate with QA and Engineering — file detailed bug reports, track issues through resolution, and proactively circle back with the customer once fixes are deployed.
  • Maintain a customer-facing communication style throughout — you represent Xenia professionally on camera with US customers and set the bar for clarity and calm under pressure.
  • Manage your own queue — track open support items, follow up without being asked, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Collaborate with Implementation and CS teams — hand off relevant context when issues touch onboarding workflows or account health, but take full ownership of the support resolution itself.
  • Contribute to our support knowledge base — document common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps so the team improves over time.


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS customer support experience — you have worked directly with business customers, not just end consumers.
  • Experience conducting live support over video (Zoom, Google Meet, or equivalent) — you are comfortable on camera and can lead a call with a customer you've never met.
  • Fluent English — spoken and written. You will be speaking with US-based operations teams, managers, and occasionally executives on camera. Clear, professional, confident communication is non-negotiable.
  • Ability to work US business hours — specifically Central or Eastern time overlap (9am–6pm CST).
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts — you can systematically work through a problem, isolate the issue, and explain what you found in plain language.
  • Organized and self-directed — you manage your own follow-ups, track open items, and close the loop without needing reminders.
  • Professional on-camera presence — reliable internet, clean background or virtual background, quality audio, and a professional demeanor during customer calls.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with operations, hospitality, restaurant, retail, or convenience store software.
  • Familiarity with feature request/issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear, or similar).
  • Experience working with a QA or engineering team to report and track issues.
  • Prior experience supporting customers in a US SaaS company from a remote/international location.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you have completed onboarding, shadowed existing support calls, and are independently running customer support sessions with light oversight.


By 60 days, you own the live support queue end-to-end — customers are getting timely responses, meetings are being booked and run efficiently, and bugs are being documented and tracked to resolution.


By 90 days, Implementation and CS are no longer fielding reactive support calls. They're focused on implementation and account growth. You are the reason why.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote position — work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct exposure to a US-based growth-stage SaaS company and its customers.
  • A small, high-trust team where your work is visible and your impact is real.
  • Opportunity to grow as Xenia scales — this role is foundational to how we build our support function.

title: Senior Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Workday Financials Consultant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the job


As a Senior Workday Financials Consultant at Aspire, you will support the Finance Solution Delivery team in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing Workday Financials. You will work across multiple financial domains, handling both production support and project-based work, while partnering with Finance stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. This role requires strong autonomy, problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, lean team environment.

What you’ll do


  • Provide hands-on configuration, support, and maintenance across multiple Workday Financials domains.

  • Contribute to backlog reduction and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday.
  • Experience supporting both production support and project-based implementations.

  • Experience with Workday Accounting Center and/or Prism is a plus.

  • Exposure to Workday Orchestrations or automation frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in lean, high-performing teams with broad ownership responsibilities.

title: Analista Contábil Fiscal Jr.

Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86ª startup mais promissora do Brasil ?

Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
  • Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
  • Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


  • Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado , mandatóriamente em PDF.
  • É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.
  • Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).
  • Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Abril/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Email Marketing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Email Marketing Specialist (Design Skill Required)


Work Schedule: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week) | Flexible working time zone.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time / Long-Term Contract


Company Overview

Our client’s company is a founder-led venture studio specializing in scaling health and wellness brands , they are hiring an experienced Email Marketing Specialist to lead lifecycle marketing across multiple brands.


The studio works closely with founders from product inception through global expansion , providing hands-on support across brand development, e-commerce, marketing, and growth strategy. Their team partners with wellness brands to build high-performing marketing systems designed for long-term scalability.


Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Email Marketing Specialist who can take ownership of email strategy across multiple e-commerce brands while managing a small team responsible for execution.


This role requires someone who is both strategic and operational — capable of planning lifecycle marketing strategies, optimizing revenue-driving flows, managing campaign calendars, and ensuring all emails meet high standards of performance and quality.

  • Manage email marketing strategy across multiple e-commerce brands

  • Oversee a small team responsible for email design, copy, and execution
  • Analyze campaign and flow performance to improve revenue
  • Run A/B tests and optimize segmentation and targeting
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to execute campaigns and maintain high-quality standards.


Requirements

  • +5 years managing email marketing for e-commerce brands
  • Proven experience managing multiple brands or accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and automated flows
  • Experience managing or coordinating designers, copywriters, or marketing contractors
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to manage campaign calendars and prioritize multiple projects
  • Experience working with high-growth consumer brands
  • Understanding of SMS marketing strategies
  • Advanced knowledge of segmentation and personalization
  • Experience scaling email revenue as a major channel for e-commerce brands


The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Is both strategic and detail-oriented
  • Has a strong understanding of e-commerce lifecycle marketing
  • Can manage both execution and team leadership
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments managing multiple brands
  • Is highly data-driven and focused on revenue growth

Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

We are looking for a high-energy, execution-driven Operations Manager to help us build and scale our company. HiLiza is building an AI-native education platform designed to support public school systems, teachers, coordinators, and education leaders. This role is ideal for someone who wants to be close to leadership, work on important company priorities, and grow with a startup.

Please send your resume and a short message explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Include examples of projects, teams, or operations work you have managed before.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Python SR (Azure) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Python SR (Azure)


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are looking for a skilled Python Developer to join our team, with proven experience in building reliable applications in Azure environments. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and be familiar with core Azure services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).   • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

Essential Skills


  • Knowledgeable in Linux;
  • DevOps or Cloud Engineering experience in a production environment;
  • Cloud Infrastructure Expertise – Hands-on experience with Azure services (Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC));

  • CI/CD Pipelines & Automation – Experience setting up Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools for automated deployments;
  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK Stack, or similar tools for system monitoring and alerting;
  • Scripting & Automation – Proficiency in Python;
  • Agile & DevOps Mindset – Experience working in Agile teams, advocating for DevOps best practices, and continuously improving infrastructure.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with AWS.

Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .

  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).

○ Elimination of Single Points of Failure (SPOFs).

○ Implementation of Security procedures, monitors, and awareness organizationally.

○ Kubernetes.

○ Linux, Windows.

○ IP Stack, WAF, Load Balancers.

○ Infrastructure-as-Code.

○ Microservices, REST API’s.

○ Ruby, Python, Golang.

  • Must have strong English communication skills (written + verbal).

Even better if you:

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.

title: Analista de Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.
  • Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.
  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Live Support Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Live Support Representative em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Live Support Representative


Xenia Platform | Remote — Brazil | Full-Time

Department

Customer Success

Location

Remote — Brazil

Employment Type

Full-Time

Language Requirement

English — Fluent (spoken & written)

Working Hours

US business hours overlap required (CST preferred)


About Xenia


Xenia is a frontline operations platform built for multi-unit operators across restaurants, retail, convenience stores, hotels, and hospitality. We help operations teams manage tasks, checklists, inspections, work orders, and team communications — all in one place. Our customers run lean teams across dozens or hundreds of locations, and they rely on Xenia to keep their operations consistent and compliant every day.


We're a Series A-stage company with a growing customer base across the United States. Our team is small, scrappy, and serious about delivering a best-in-class experience to the frontline operators who trust us.


The Role


We are hiring a Live Support Representative to serve as the dedicated live support contact for Xenia customers — handling support over Zoom and Google Meet, not just email or chat queues.


This role exists to own the customer-facing support experience end-to-end: meeting with customers directly over video, troubleshooting issues in real time, answering product questions, and coordinating with our internal QA and engineering teams to ensure bugs get resolved and customers hear back with a clear answer.


Today, this burden falls on our Implementation and Customer Success teams — slowing down onboarding and strategic account work. Your job is to take that entirely off their plate. You will be the first point of escalation for customers who need live support, whether they are three weeks into implementation or two years post-launch.


What You'll Do

  • Own the live support channel — host Zoom and Google Meet sessions with US-based customers to troubleshoot issues, answer product questions, and resolve blockers in real time.
  • Support customers at every stage — whether they are mid-implementation, newly live, or long-tenured accounts, you provide consistent, knowledgeable support.
  • Triage and document issues — clearly document bugs, unexpected behaviors, and feature questions; distinguish between user error, configuration issues, and genuine software bugs.
  • Coordinate with QA and Engineering — file detailed bug reports, track issues through resolution, and proactively circle back with the customer once fixes are deployed.
  • Maintain a customer-facing communication style throughout — you represent Xenia professionally on camera with US customers and set the bar for clarity and calm under pressure.
  • Manage your own queue — track open support items, follow up without being asked, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Collaborate with Implementation and CS teams — hand off relevant context when issues touch onboarding workflows or account health, but take full ownership of the support resolution itself.
  • Contribute to our support knowledge base — document common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps so the team improves over time.


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 2+ years of B2B SaaS customer support experience — you have worked directly with business customers, not just end consumers.
  • Experience conducting live support over video (Zoom, Google Meet, or equivalent) — you are comfortable on camera and can lead a call with a customer you've never met.
  • Fluent English — spoken and written. You will be speaking with US-based operations teams, managers, and occasionally executives on camera. Clear, professional, confident communication is non-negotiable.
  • Ability to work US business hours — specifically Central or Eastern time overlap (9am–6pm CST).
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts — you can systematically work through a problem, isolate the issue, and explain what you found in plain language.
  • Organized and self-directed — you manage your own follow-ups, track open items, and close the loop without needing reminders.
  • Professional on-camera presence — reliable internet, clean background or virtual background, quality audio, and a professional demeanor during customer calls.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with operations, hospitality, restaurant, retail, or convenience store software.
  • Familiarity with feature request/issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear, or similar).
  • Experience working with a QA or engineering team to report and track issues.
  • Prior experience supporting customers in a US SaaS company from a remote/international location.


What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you have completed onboarding, shadowed existing support calls, and are independently running customer support sessions with light oversight.


By 60 days, you own the live support queue end-to-end — customers are getting timely responses, meetings are being booked and run efficiently, and bugs are being documented and tracked to resolution.


By 90 days, Implementation and CS are no longer fielding reactive support calls. They're focused on implementation and account growth. You are the reason why.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote position — work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct exposure to a US-based growth-stage SaaS company and its customers.
  • A small, high-trust team where your work is visible and your impact is real.
  • Opportunity to grow as Xenia scales — this role is foundational to how we build our support function.

description:

Hi,

Fractional Account Manager — Partnerships & Growth

Remote Part-Time (Fractional)

Full Time

Why this role exists

Millions of people in the US rely on self-pay healthcare. They face high costs, limited access, and poor transparency.

We are building a membership-based platform that delivers affordable access to care, including primary care, labs, imaging, and prescriptions. Our infrastructure is in place. Growth now depends on strong partner execution and account management.

This is an ownership-driven account management role.

• Ensure high partner engagement and retention

• Maintain pipeline visibility and reporting discipline

• Coordinate with internal teams to resolve partner issues quickly

• Improve processes that drive partner success and scalability

• Account growth across existing partners

• Higher partner conversion rates

• Strong retention and repeat engagement

• Consistent communication cadence with partners

• Clear reporting on account health and performance

Who we’re looking for

• 1-3 years of experience in account management, partnerships, or healthcare sales

• Experience working with brokers, employers, or channel partners

• Strong relationship management and communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple accounts with clear prioritization

• Experience working remotely with high ownership and discipline

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

• Mission-driven mindset around improving healthcare access

Strongly preferred

• Experience in healthcare, benefits, or insurance distribution

• Exposure to broker-driven sales models

• Experience in ICHRA or small employer benefits

• Existing relationships with brokers or channel partners

As a Sr. Claude Developer, you are responsible for delivering high‑impact features in a fast‑moving, AI‑assisted development environment. You are deeply experienced in AI‑driven and agentic development workflows, using tools such as Claude and/or Cursor to significantly increase development speed, quality, and iteration velocity.   • Demonstrated experience with agentic development workflows, using AI to plan, iterate, validate solutions, and accelerate engineering tasks from end‑to‑end.

  • Fluent or very strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross‑functional teams.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)

  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup

Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.


O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil


Nossa Proposta de Valor:

  • Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.
  • Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.
  • Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.


E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Confira esta oportunidade para SUPERVISOR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aqui está uma descrição de vaga detalhada e atraente para o cargo de Supervisor de Depósito:

A Empresa XYZ está em busca de um profissional dedicado e experiente para assumir o cargo de Supervisor de Depósito em nossa moderna instalação logística. Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar e supervisionar uma equipe de profissionais do depósito, garantindo a eficiência e a excelência operacional.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, organizar e supervisionar todas as atividades do depósito, incluindo recebimento, armazenagem, picking, embalagem e expedição de mercadorias.
  • Coordenar e orientar a equipe de colaboradores do depósito, garantindo a execução precisa e oportuna de todas as tarefas.
  • Implementar e monitorar procedimentos operacionais, a fim de maximizar a produtividade e minimizar desperdícios.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua e implementar soluções inovadoras para elevar a eficiência do depósito.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de todos os padrões de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável.
  • Analisar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para a gerência, fornecendo insights valiosos sobre o desempenho do depósito.
  • Colaborar com outras equipes, como compras, vendas e transporte, para garantir uma integração perfeita entre os departamentos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Logística, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada de no mínimo 3 anos em supervisão de depósitos ou operações logísticas.
  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação eficaz e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de estoques, armazenagem e controle de processos logísticos.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gerenciamento de armazém (WMS) e ferramentas de automação.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões estratégicas e resolver problemas de forma ágil e eficiente.
  • Fluência em inglês é um diferencial.

O que a Empresa XYZ oferece

  • Pacote de remuneração e benefícios altamente competitivo.
  • Ambiente de trabalho moderno e colaborativo, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Treinamentos constantes para aprimorar suas habilidades.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento dentro da organização.
  • Seguro de saúde e outros benefícios corporativos.

Junte-se à nossa equipe de excelência e contribua para o crescimento da Empresa XYZ. Candidate-se agora e faça parte dessa jornada emocionante!
